name: prompt-grader
description: Grades how each Claude Code session opened, once the first prompt has resolved, and shows suggestions in a side panel. Uses Jev on OpenRouter and Anthropic's general and per-model prompting guidance; spends no Claude tokens.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used to call Jev, the grading model, on OpenRouter. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys. Leave empty if OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set in Claude Code's environment.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: live: grade and show the side panel. log: grade and log only. off: do nothing.
